read.robot: PandaWristCam (uid panda_wristcam) subclasses Panda and inherits its controller configurations
read.arm_pd_ee_delta_pos: PDEEPosControllerConfig(pos_lower=-0.1, pos_upper=0.1, stiffness=1e3, damping=1e2, force_limit=100); frame root_translation, use_delta, no virtual target (use_target is True only in the separate pd_ee_target_delta_pos mode), normalised action. The 3 arm values in [-1, 1] are scaled to [-0.1, 0.1] m and added to the CURRENT end-effector position in the robot base frame; the IK joint target is then driven by the joint PD controller
read.gripper: PDJointPosMimicControllerConfig(lower=-0.01, upper=0.04), absolute target, normalised action: command -1 -> -0.01 m per finger (closed, squeezing), +1 -> 0.04 m per finger (open)
read.consequence: because there is no virtual target, the target is re-anchored at the measured pose every control step: the part of a commanded increment that was not achieved is not carried over to the next step
